title: Sandwich Reasoning: An Answer-Reasoning-Answer Approach for Low-Latency Query Correction
abstract: arXiv:2601.03672v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Query correction is a critical entry point in modern search pipelines, demanding high accuracy strictly within real-time latency constraints. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves accuracy but incurs prohibitive latency for real-time query correction. A potential solution is to output an answer before reasoning to reduce latency; however, under autoregressive decoding, the early answer is independent of subsequent reasoning, preventing the model from leveraging its reasoning capability to improve accuracy. To address this issue, we propose Sandwich Reasoning (SandwichR), a novel approach that explicitly aligns a fast initial answer with post-hoc reasoning, enabling low-latency query correction without sacrificing reasoning-aware accuracy. translated_title: 三明治推理：一种面向低延迟查询纠错的“答案-推理-答案”方法
translated_abstract: 查询纠错是现代搜索流水线中的关键入口环节，需要在严格的实时延迟约束内实现高准确率。思维链推理虽然能提升准确率，但对于实时查询纠错而言其延迟过高、难以接受。一种潜在的解决方案是先输出答案再进行推理以降低延迟；然而，在自回归解码机制下，早期答案与后续推理相互独立，导致模型无法利用其推理能力来提升准确率。为解决这一问题，我们提出了三明治推理，这是一种新颖的方法，它显式地将快速生成的初始答案与事后推理进行对齐，从而在不牺牲推理感知准确率的前提下实现低延迟查询纠错。SandwichR遵循“答案-推理-答案”范式：先生成初始纠错结果，再进行显式推理过程，最后输出经过精炼的最终纠错结果。为了将初始答案与事后推理对齐……
tldr: 提出三明治推理方法，通过“答案-推理-答案”范式将快速初始答案与后续显式推理对齐，在不牺牲推理带来的准确率提升的同时，实现满足实时延迟约束的查询纠错。
en_tdlr: Sandwich Reasoning (SandwichR) adopts an Answer-Reasoning-Answer paradigm that explicitly aligns a fast initial answer with post-hoc reasoning, enabling low-latency query correction without sacrificing reasoning-aware accuracy.
